label: SPE
description: Arm Statistical Profiling Extension (SPE) 寄存器

registers.name: PMSFCR_EL1
registers.description: SPE 软件过滤控制寄存器。控制 Profiling Buffer 中指令计数的包含/排除。FEAT_SPE 时存在。

fields.name: FDS
fields.description: [When FEAT_SPE_FDS is implemented] Filter by 数据源. If PMSFCR_EL1.FDS is 1 and PMSDSFR_EL1 is zero, then no load 操作s with a 数据源 will be recorded. Load 操作s without a 数据源 and other sampled 操作s are unaffected by this field. [0b0=; 0b1=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: FP
fields.description: [When FEAT_SPE_EFT is implemented] Floating-point 过滤器 enable. This field is ignored by the PE and no records are removed by this 过滤器 when any of the following apply: For 过滤器ing purposes, floating-point 操作s means all scalar, Advanced SIMD, SVE, and SME floating-point 操作s, as defined by the FP_SPEC 事件. [0b0=; 0b1=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: FL
fields.description: Filter by latency. If PMSFCR_EL1.FL is 1 and PMSLATFR_EL1.MINLAT is zero, then for each sampled 操作, it is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE whether the sample is discarded or the PE behaves as if PMSFCR_EL1.FL is 0. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: FT
fields.description: Filter by type. The 过滤器 is controlled by the TYPE and, if FEAT_SPE_EFT is implemented, TYPEm fields. Type 过滤器ing 过滤器s according to the type of the sampled 操作. If FEAT_SPE_EFT is not implemented, PMSFCR_EL1.FT is 1, and the PMSFCR_EL1.{ST, LD, B} bits are all zero, then for each sampled 操作, it is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE whether the sample is discarded or the PE behaves as if PMSFCR_EL1.FT is 0. For more information, see Filtering by 操作 type. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: B
fields.description: Branch 过滤器 enable. This field is ignored by the PE and no records are removed by this 过滤器 when any of the following apply: For 过滤器ing purposes, branch 操作s includes exception returns. [0b0=; 0b1=]
